info.title: Google Maps Business API: Places, Phones, Ratings and Leads
info.description:
Google Maps businesses for any search and city as JSON: phone, website, address parts, rating, review count, hours, place id and a lead score.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/google-maps-business (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Returns Google Maps places for any search and location: name, phone, website, address parts, coordinates, rating, review count, opening hours, categories, place id and a lead score. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

query.title: Search query
query.description: What to search for on Google Maps, as you would type it there: a kind of business ("dentist", "coffee shop"), a brand or a business name. Searched in the location below.

location.title: Location
location.description: City, district, state or country to search in, for example "San Francisco, CA", "Mitte, Berlin" or "Texas".

queries.title: More search queries
queries.description: Several search queries for one request. Each query is searched in each location, and a place found by two searches is saved once.

locations.title: More locations
locations.description: Several locations for one request, for example a list of cities. Each query is searched in each of them.

maxResults.title: Maximum places per search
maxResults.description: Places to return for each search (each query in each location). A request returns 20 places at most.

startUrls.title: Place links, place ids or search links
startUrls.description: Google Maps place links, place ids (ChIJ…), feature ids (0x…:0x…) or Google Maps search links. Each place is read from its own page, every link is read regardless of the limit above. A search link is run as a search; a link with a map position (…/@37.76,-122.41,15z) searches that part of the map.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "search" runs the queries and reads the links. "direct_urls" reads only the links and ignores the query fields.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Save only places with at least this star rating (1.0 to 5.0). Places without a rating are left out.

minReviews.title: Minimum number of reviews
minReviews.description: Save only places with at least this many reviews.

websiteFilter.title: Website filter
websiteFilter.description: "has_website" saves only places with a website, "no_website" only places without one (prospects for web design and local marketing).

skipClosedPlaces.title: Skip permanently closed places
skipClosedPlaces.description: Leave out places Google marks as permanently closed. `skipClosed` is read as well.

requireWebsite.title: Only places with a website
requireWebsite.description: Save only places that list a website, the same as websiteFilter "has_website".

includeReviews.title: Full details and reviews
includeReviews.description: Reads each place's own page as well: price range, every group of Google's "About" tab, the number of 1 to 5 star reviews and the reviews Google shows a visitor on the overview (eight at most, with author, rating, text and date). One more request per place, about four places a second. Without it a row has what Google's result list carried.

maxReviews.title: Maximum reviews per place
maxReviews.description: Reviews to keep per place when reviews are included. Google shows a visitor eight at most.

includePhotos.title: Include photo links
includePhotos.description: Adds `photos`: the photo links in Google's record of the place, between 1 and about 20. The main photo is always in `image_url`.

includeLeadScore.title: Include lead score
includeLeadScore.description: Adds a score from 0 to 100 computed from the row itself: website and phone present, rating, number of reviews, opening hours, photos.

scrapeContacts.title: Emails, social links and contact form from the website
scrapeContacts.description: Reads each place's website (home, contact, Kontakt, Impressum and about pages) and adds primary_email, emails, socials and has_contact_form to the row. Included in the place price, no extra event. Adds a few seconds per place; places without a website get empty fields.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of categories, opening hours and descriptions, as a language code: en, de, fr, es, it, pt-BR, ja.

countryCode.title: Country of the visitor
countryCode.description: Two-letter country code Google is told the visitor is in. It decides the format of addresses and phone numbers: with "us" a US phone is "(415) 772-9060", a German one "+49 30 81455310"; with "de" the German one is "030 81455310".

excludePlaceUrls.title: Exclude place links
excludePlaceUrls.description: Skip these places, given as long Google Maps place links.

excludePlaceIds.title: Exclude place ids
excludePlaceIds.description: Skip these places, given as place ids (ChIJ…), numeric CIDs or feature ids (0x…:0x…).

201.description: The results, one object per row.

example.name: Piccolo Forno
example.description: Casual neighborhood trattoria with Italian classics & espresso in colorful, contemporary quarters.

400.description: The request body does not fit the input fields. The message says which field.
